competences.description: Attacks the enemy to absorb the Attack Bar by 15% with a 50% chance.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to remove all beneficial effects with an 80% chance and stuns the enemy with a 50% chance.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Increases your Attack Speed by 5%, up to 100%, for each beneficial effect granted on the enemies and allies. In addition, inflicts additional damage that ignores Defense in proportion to your Attack Speed when you attack the enemy on your turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be increased by 30%.
effets.note: For each beneficial effect granted on the enemies and allies

effets.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.
effets.note: Ignores Defense in proportion to your Attack Speed when you attack the enemy on your turn.
